paragraphs.text: 1. THY right hand have we grasped in ours, O Indra, longing for treasure, Treasure-Lord of treasures!
paragraphs.original: जगृभ्मा ते दक्षिणमिन्द्र हस्तं वसूयवो वसुपते वसूनाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: jagṛbhmā te dakṣiṇamindra hastaṃ vasūyavo vasupate vasūnām |

paragraphs.text: Because we know thee, Hero, Lord of cattle: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
paragraphs.original: विद्मा हि त्वा गोपतिं शूर गोनामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः
paragraphs.translit: vidmā hi tvā gopatiṃ śūra gonāmasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Wealth, fully armed, good guard and kind protector, sprung from four seas, the prop and stay of treasures,
paragraphs.original: स्वायुधं स्ववसं सुनीथं चतुःसमुद्रं धरुणं रयीणाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: svāyudhaṃ svavasaṃ sunīthaṃ catuḥsamudraṃ dharuṇaṃ rayīṇām |

paragraphs.text: Fraught with great bounties, meet for praise and glory; vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
paragraphs.original: चर्कृत्यं शंस्यं भूरिवारमस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः
paragraphs.translit: carkṛtyaṃ śaṃsyaṃ bhūrivāramasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Wealth, with good Brahmans, Indra! God-attended, high, wide, and deep, arid based on broad foundations,
Strong, with famed Rsis, conquering our foemen: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
4. Victorious, winning strength, with hero sages, confirmed in power, most useful, wealth-attracting,
paragraphs.original: सनद्वाजं विप्रवीरं तरुत्रं धनस्पृतं शूशुवांसं सुदक्षम् ।
paragraphs.translit: sanadvājaṃ vipravīraṃ tarutraṃ dhanaspṛtaṃ śūśuvāṃsaṃ sudakṣam |

paragraphs.text: True, Indra! crushing forts and slaying Dasyus: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
paragraphs.original: दस्युहनं पूर्भिदमिन्द्र सत्यमस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः
paragraphs.translit: dasyuhanaṃ pūrbhidamindra satyamasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Wealthy in heroes and in cars and horses, strength hundredfold and thousand fold, O Indra,
paragraphs.original: अश्वावन्तं रथिनं वीरवन्तं सहस्रिणं शतिनं वाजमिन्द्र ।
paragraphs.translit: aśvāvantaṃ rathinaṃ vīravantaṃ sahasriṇaṃ śatinaṃ vājamindra |

paragraphs.text: With manly sages, happy troops, light-winning: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
paragraphs.original: भद्रव्रातं विप्रवीरं स्वर्षामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः
paragraphs.translit: bhadravrātaṃ vipravīraṃ svarṣāmasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. To Saptagu the sage, the holy-minded, to him, Brhaspati, the song approaches,
paragraphs.original: प्र सप्तगुमृतधीतिं सुमेधां बृहस्पतिं मतिरच्छा जिगाति ।
paragraphs.translit: pra saptagumṛtadhītiṃ sumedhāṃ bṛhaspatiṃ matiracchā jigāti |

paragraphs.text: Angiras' Son who must be met with homage: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
paragraphs.original: य आङ्गिरसो नमसोपसद्योऽस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः
paragraphs.translit: ya āṅgiraso namasopasadyo'smabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. My lauds, like envoys, craving loving-kindness, go forth to Indra with their strong entreaty,
paragraphs.original: वनीवानो मम दूतास इन्द्रं स्तोमाश्चरन्ति सुमतीरियानाः ।
paragraphs.translit: vanīvāno mama dūtāsa indraṃ stomāścaranti sumatīriyānāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Moving his heart and uttered by my spirit: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
paragraphs.original: हृदिस्पृशो मनसा वच्यमाना अस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः
paragraphs.translit: hṛdispṛśo manasā vacyamānā asmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. Grant us the boon for which I pray, O Indra, a spacious home unmatched among the people.
paragraphs.original: यत्त्वा यामि दद्धि तन्न इन्द्र बृहन्तं क्षयमसमं जनानाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yattvā yāmi daddhi tanna indra bṛhantaṃ kṣayamasamaṃ janānām |

paragraphs.text: To this may Heaven and Earth accord approval: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches.
paragraphs.original: अभि तद्द्यावापृथिवी गृणीतामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणं रयिं दाः
paragraphs.translit: abhi taddyāvāpṛthivī gṛṇītāmasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
